descricao_original: The fundic region of the stomach possesses a sheet gland, which forms the lining of the stomach. The multicellular sheet gland is an epithelial layer composed entirely of mucus-secreting cells. The mucus produced by this layer protects the stomach tissues from the acidic contents of the organ. Fundic stomach 200x
